annotations.title: EU Tender Alerts: Public Procurement by Country and CPV

description: Find recent EU public procurement notices by buyer country, CPV code, keyword and notice type. Returns title, buyer organisation, CPV codes, deadline, estimated value and a link. Buyer organisations only, no contact persons. Run it on a schedule with publishedSince to get new tenders. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

country.description: Buyer country, ISO 3166 alpha-3 (DNK, DEU, SWE ...).

cpv.description: CPV codes or prefixes with a trailing * (e.g. "72*" for IT services).

deadlineAfter.description: Only notices whose tender deadline is on or after this date.

keyword.description: Full-text keyword or words (letters, digits, spaces, hyphens).

noticeType.description: TED notice type, e.g. cn-standard (contract notice) or can-standard (award).

publishedSince.description: Only notices published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 7 days ago.
